A thousand metre du" → 5 lines (11 words, 134.4px, a paragraph set above 36px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 10 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Locally owned, NTB registered" above "The best way to see Namibia is with peop"; "Where we go" above "Signature tours, shaped around you."; "Signature tour" above "Windhoek, Sossusvlei, Swakopmund, Spitzk"; "Southern Namibia" above "Kalahari, Quiver Tree Forest and Fish Ri"; "Wildlife focus" above "Etosha National Park and Waterberg Tour"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 18 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Locally owned, NTB registered", "Signature routes", "Guided experiences", "Locally owned").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 2 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.relative.mt-4 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.relative.z-10 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 2 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): section.border-y.border-rose-200 1440px | div.border-t.border-white/10 1440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 1 box(es) drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Prefer a filled surface or no box.

findings.message: 2 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Where we go" 4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Signature tour" 4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Wildlife focus" 4:1 needs 4.5:1; "Southern Namibia" 4:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Schibsted Grotesk, Archivo, Kaushan Script).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.2:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 19 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Broken image(s): https://ligertours.com/_next/image?url=%2Fimagery%2Fcrops%2Fwindhoek-christuskirche-1x1.webp&w=640&q=75, https://ligertours.com/_next/image?url=%2Fimagery%2Fcrops%2Fsundowner-drinks-sunset-1x1.webp&w=640&q=75, https://ligertours.com/_next/image?url=%2Fimagery%2Fcrops%2Fcampfire-cooking-pot-1x1.webp&w=640&q=75
findings.fix: Fix the URL or replace the asset.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (80px, 744px, 760px, 510px, 258px, 340px, 955px); the three most used hold only 46% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "GUIDED BY LOCALS" (screen 1, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Five" (screen 5, 100% over a picture); "hundred" (screen 5, 100% over a picture); "year" (screen 5, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: 3 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 772px at 10284px; 804px at 11728px; 1276px at 12800px (the screen is 844px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 6 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "English", "Current", "Deutsch", "Français"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
